The founding charter of the modern national security system. It created the National Security Council and the Central Intelligence Agency, established a separate Air Force, and placed the military departments under a single Secretary of Defense.

::: {.official-links}
**Read the law** (official GovInfo text)

[Enacted text: 61 Stat. 495](https://www.govinfo.gov/link/statute/61/495){.btn-official} [Current U.S. Code: 50 U.S.C. 3001 et seq.](https://www.govinfo.gov/link/uscode/50/3002?link-type=html){.btn-official}
:::

## Key provisions

- Title I: National Security Council and Central Intelligence Agency; since 2004 also the Director of National Intelligence.
- Title II: the National Military Establishment, which 1949 amendments turned into the Department of Defense.
- Title V (added 1980, expanded 1991): congressional oversight of intelligence, including covert action findings at 50 U.S.C. 3093.
- Sec. 108 (50 U.S.C. 3043): the annual National Security Strategy report, added in 1986.

## Why it matters

Most later reorganizations are amendments to this act, including the [Goldwater-Nichols Act](goldwater-nichols-1986.qmd), the [Intel Oversight Act](intel-oversight-1980.qmd), and [IRTPA](irtpa-2004.qmd). If a question concerns who is in charge of what in national security, the answer usually starts here.

## Current status

In force and amended many times. Its Title 50 sections were renumbered in 2013 (for example, old section 413b on covert action is now section 3093).

[Last checked November 10, 2026.]{.checked}

## Where it sits

- **Layer.** Framework statute. Standing laws that create institutions or general procedures other laws and executive actions plug into, such as the National Security Act, the War Powers Resolution, IEEPA, and FISA. ([How the layers work](../study/index.qmd#the-authority-stack))
- **Built upon by.** [CIA Act](cia-act-1949.qmd), [Intel Oversight Act](intel-oversight-1980.qmd), [IRTPA](irtpa-2004.qmd), [Goldwater-Nichols Act](goldwater-nichols-1986.qmd), [DoD Reorganization Act (1958)](dod-reorg-1958.qmd), [NSA Amendments (1949)](nsa-amendments-1949.qmd).
- **Codified in.** [Title 50 U.S.C.](title50-usc.qmd).
- **Era.** Building the national security state ([timeline](../study/timeline.qmd)).
- **Study.** [Unit 2: Building the national security state, 1947 to 1958](../study/units/national-security-state.qmd) (core reading); [Unit 6: Intelligence and its oversight](../study/units/intelligence-oversight.qmd) (core reading); [Unit 7: Surveillance law](../study/units/surveillance.qmd) (further reading).
- **Who's involved.** [HPSCI](../whos-who.qmd#hpsci), [SSCI](../whos-who.qmd#ssci), [NSC](../whos-who.qmd#nsc), [DoD](../whos-who.qmd#dod), [JCS](../whos-who.qmd#jcs), [ODNI](../whos-who.qmd#odni), [CIA](../whos-who.qmd#cia).
